name: Selixer
summary: Shopify profit dashboard that nets ad spend, COGS, returns and fees out of revenue and reports what you keep per product, campaign and customer, built for fashion and apparel brands.
best_for: Shopify fashion and apparel brands with real ad spend that want profit per SKU and per campaign in one place, and can carry the $299 tier where those features actually live
skip_if: your store is small enough that a spreadsheet still works, you need more than three connected ad accounts without paying $399, or you want a longer public track record than an app launched in May 2026 with two reviews
honest_knock:
Read the feature lists rather than the prices and the entry tier stops looking like the product. Essence at $149 a month gives you two seats, one connected ad platform, a year of history and an inventory health score. The full True Profit waterfall, the per-product P&L and the POAS and CAC tracking, the reason anyone installs a profit dashboard, all start on Catalyst at $299. So the real price of what this app is sold on is double the headline.

The ad-platform caps decide the tier as much as the features do: one, then two, then three. If you run Meta, Google and TikTok you are on the $399 plan for connectivity alone, whatever your revenue looks like.

The monthly figure is also not the whole bill. Each plan carries an AI credit allowance (500, 2,000 and 3,000) and the listing sells top-ups from $25, with usage-based charges billed on the same 30-day cycle. Find out what spends a credit before you budget around the headline.

And this is a new app. It launched on 19 May 2026 and had two public reviews on 10 November 2026. There is nothing bad in the record, but there is barely any record, and this is a tool you hand your cost prices, your ad spend and your margins to. Use the 14-day trial to reconcile its numbers against a month you have already closed in your own books before you trust a dashboard you cannot yet audit.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essence · per month for two user seats, one connected ad platform and a year of historical data
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/selixer and in our own trial account the same day; amounts unchanged since 10 September 2026) Three tiers on the listing, Essence $149, Catalyst $299 and Aether $399 a month, no free plan, each with a 14 day free trial. Essence $149 a month: two user seats, one connected ad platform, a year of historical data, the ad dashboard with campaigns and trends, stockout, overstock and dead-stock views, an inventory health score, 500 AI credits with top-ups from $25, and a site speed analyzer. Catalyst $299 a month adds four seats, two ad platforms and no date cap on history, the full True Profit waterfall, POAS, CAC and product-level ad revenue, per-product P&L and an SKU action matrix, a WhatsApp inbox with AI agent and campaigns, 50,000 emails a month with branded invoices, and 2,000 AI credits. Aether $399 a month adds eight seats, three ad platforms, all 10 profit-leak detectors (nine on the 19 September reading), multi-touch attribution and ad cohorts, demand forecasting and return on inventory, RFM scoring and retention cohorts, automations with 200,000 emails a month, and 3,000 AI credits. The listing publishes no annual rate, so all three are monthly. Charges are billed in USD, and the listing files recurring and usage-based charges together on the same 30-day cycle — the AI credits are the usage part, with top-ups starting at $25. Inside the app, in our own test on 17 November 2026, a fourth plan appeared that the listing does not show: Varta at $49 a month, an email and WhatsApp CRM with 25,000 emails a month and 4 team seats (more at $10 a seat), without store analytics, ads, AI Studio or invoicing. The app's own Aether card and comparison table count 9 profit leak detectors where the listing says 10 (2 on Catalyst, 1 as a preview on Essence), and on a Catalyst trial the billing screen showed 100 AI credits available where the plan card says 2,000 to start. The trial needed no card; it carries trial limits on what costs per use (5 AI Studio images and 10 custom products). An account opened on selixer.com is billed by card through Stripe rather than through Shopify. Developer Akaame Export Private Limited; the app launched 19 May 2026 and carried two App Store reviews on 17 November 2026, both five stars. Two details on the same page as the plans: the entry card is labelled Essance while the Catalyst card's feature list calls the same tier Essence, and the App Store record now shows two five star reviews; on our September reading there was one, from a merchant who had used the app for 15 days.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in our Shopify development store on the 14 day Catalyst trial. We installed Selixer, synced products and orders, compared the counts with our Shopify admin, read the AI credits and billing pages, and removed the app. We chose no plan, so nothing was charged.
findings: Install: after the Shopify install, Selixer asked us to add the store to our Selixer account and pick a plan. Every plan offered a 14 day free trial with no card, and no Shopify charge screen appeared.
Prices on 22 November 2026 in the app, a month after the trial: Varta $49, Essence $149, Catalyst $299 and Aether $399. We took the Catalyst trial.
Products: the sync worked. Selixer listed 23 products, 32 SKUs and 778 units, the same 23 products as our Shopify admin.

Orders: the list said No orders found after a sync and after a second sync past the 5 minute cooldown, although our development store had two test orders worth $1,449.90 (no real money). Net sales, profit and orders on the dashboard stayed at 0, so we could not check the profit figures.
AI credits: the Catalyst trial showed 100 AI credits, while the listing names 2,000 for Catalyst. Top-ups run from $25 for 1,500 credits to $400 for 30,000.
Billing: the page showed the Catalyst trial from 22 November to 6 December 2026, billed by Shopify, and said nothing is charged until you choose a plan.
Ads: connecting Meta Ads or Google Ads needs a sign-in to an ad account. Our test store has none, so we skipped that step.
not_tested: profit per order, product and campaign: orders did not sync and no ad account was connected
WhatsApp COD verification and email campaigns
